titles.display: Battle of the Golden Spurs

raw.extract: The Battle of the Golden Spurs or Battle of Courtrai was a military confrontation between the royal army of France and rebellious forces of the County of Flanders on 11 July 1302 during the 1297–1305 Franco-Flemish War. It took place near the town of Kortrijk in modern-day Belgium and resulted in an unexpected Flemish victory.
